description: Candidate list for AI-Assistant-Triage. Classification per criteria.md K01-K03. Watchlist entries are unverified leads, not scores.

fields.status: scorecard = has a file in scorecards/; watchlist = lead, no scorecard yet
fields.mcp: remote | local | both | none | unknown, as reported by the source
fields.evidence: vendor-doc-search-snippet = vendor doc seen only via search result, page not read; third-party = blog/directory only; none-found = no evidence of connectors. No watchlist entry counts as confirmed under the repo's research rules until the source page is read.
fields.recommend: strong | maybe | skip: fit with Daniel's top limits (read-write Google Workspace, multiple accounts per connector), set when the lead was added
fields.multi_account: whether one connector can hold several accounts (C08), with evidence

candidates.note: Comet browser treated as part of this entry, not a separate candidate.

candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Voice-first; developers add MCP servers, not end users. Borderline scope.

candidates.name: LibreChat

candidates.name: Open WebUI

candidates.name: AnythingLLM

candidates.name: Witsy

candidates.name: 5ire

candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Project activity not checked.

candidates.name: Goose
candidates.connectors: Extensions are MCP servers; custom MCP servers; desktop app and CLI
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Also a coding agent: scope check before scoring.

candidates.name: Lindy (Lindy Assistant)
candidates.connectors: 1,500+ integrations; Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook; Drive listed by directories; reachable via web chat, Slack, iMessage/SMS, email, Chrome extension
candidates.mcp: remote (docs: 'Lindy supports MCP, any MCP server your team runs plugs straight in')
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Multi-inbox limit by tier per product page: Plus 2, Pro 3, Max 5, Enterprise custom. Per-integration write guardrails (always allow / require approval / don't offer). Verify: chat-first? per-account naming/selection in prompts; Drive and Contacts write; attachments.
candidates.google_workspace: Gmail+Calendar read/write (draft/send/triage; book/reschedule). Drive: integration exists, actions not documented in pages read. Contacts: not seen.
candidates.multi_account: yes (docs: 'as many inboxes as you like, across both providers'; each shown as chip with its email address; integration docs: 'tools that support more than one login, like Gmail, you can add further accounts under the same integration'). Unclear how agent picks the inbox. Google Calendar multi-account not confirmed (community thread says default calendar only).
candidates.recommend_why: Only candidate found with documented multi-account Google, per-tier inbox limits, custom MCP and write guardrails.

candidates.name: Relevance AI (Invent / agents)
candidates.connectors: Gmail integration (search, read, thread, attachments read, send, reply, draft), many other integrations; MCP server (exposes agents to outside clients)
candidates.mcp: unclear (MCP server page found; MCP client page not read)
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Agent-builder first, chat is secondary. Need to read the MCP client page and Drive/Calendar docs.
candidates.google_workspace: Gmail read/write incl. reading attachments; sending with attachments not stated. Drive/Calendar not checked.
candidates.multi_account: yes (FAQ: 'connect multiple Gmail accounts ... configure different agents to work with specific accounts'); selection via dropdown; per-agent binding rather than per-prompt.
candidates.recommend_why: Documented multi-Gmail, but binds account per agent and is a builder platform more than a chat assistant.

candidates.name: Superhuman Go / Superhuman Mail MCP
candidates.connectors: Go is an MCP client with a Connectors panel (Zapier MCP connector, 9,000+ apps); Superhuman Mail MCP exposes Gmail+Outlook inboxes and calendar to Claude/ChatGPT
candidates.mcp: client (Go via Zapier MCP); server (Mail MCP, Business plan or higher)
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Two angles: (a) Mail MCP is a multi-account Gmail/Outlook bridge usable from other chat clients (needs Business plan); (b) Go as a general assistant is under-documented, need to confirm scope. Attachments and Drive not mentioned.
candidates.google_workspace: Gmail+Calendar read/write (search, summarize, draft, send with approval) across accounts. Drive not mentioned.
candidates.multi_account: yes (page: 'Connect all your Gmail and Outlook accounts, including work, personal, and side projects'; says Claude native connectors are single-account).
candidates.recommend_why: Strong multi-account Gmail claim, but a mail-centric product; useful mainly as an MCP bridge into already-scored clients.

candidates.name: Tasklet
candidates.connectors: Chat threads with agents; Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar listed; thousands of SaaS tools, any API
candidates.mcp: remote ('Any MCP server' in connection list)
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Homepage only; no docs read. Third-party (Revdoku) claims single mailbox per connection, unverified.
candidates.google_workspace: Gmail, Drive, Calendar named on homepage; read/write scope not read.
candidates.multi_account: unknown (homepage silent; third-party suggests one mailbox per connection)
candidates.recommend_why: Chat plus custom MCP plus Google apps, worth reading docs for multi-account.

candidates.name: Dust
candidates.connectors: Agents with tools; Google Calendar tool uses personal credentials; Google Drive is a synced knowledge connection; Remote MCP servers (admin adds)
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Team/enterprise oriented. Admin adds remote MCP. Gmail tool not found in pages read.
candidates.google_workspace: Calendar via personal credentials (r/w not stated). Drive: sync for retrieval, no write documented. Gmail: not found.
candidates.multi_account: unknown (docs describe one personal connection per tool; an unverified changelog claims multi-account for Gmail/Drive/Calendar, may not be Dust)
candidates.recommend_why: Good remote MCP, but Google is retrieval-only on Drive and multi-account unproven.

candidates.name: Poke
candidates.connectors: Messaging-channel assistant (SMS/iMessage/app); Gmail, Outlook inboxes, calendars, contacts sync; custom integrations via MCP
candidates.mcp: remote (FAQ: build and add custom integrations using MCP)
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Chat via messaging, not a web chat. FAQ states no multi-phone-number support; silent on multiple email accounts.
candidates.google_workspace: Gmail, Calendar, Contacts sync supported; Drive not mentioned; read/write not stated.
candidates.recommend_why: Custom MCP lets you attach a multi-account Google MCP, but native multi-account is unknown.

candidates.name: Gumloop Agents
candidates.connectors: Agents in web app and Slack; Gmail MCP connector; 50+ prebuilt MCP servers; personal vs workspace credentials
candidates.mcp: remote (HTTPS, Streamable HTTP/SSE; bearer, header, OAuth discovery; Enterprise managed tunnels reach internal servers)
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Reaches self-hosted infra only on Enterprise (tunnels); otherwise public HTTPS. Multiple credentials per service not documented.
candidates.multi_account: unknown (docs mention personal vs workspace credentials only; possibly add same server twice)
candidates.recommend_why: Solid custom remote MCP with named personal credentials, multi-account unverified.

candidates.name: Zapier Agents / Zapier MCP
candidates.connectors: Agents with chat ('Chat when needed'), 9,000+ apps; Zapier MCP exposes connected apps to other clients
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Zapier connections are per app account and a Zapier app step can pick any saved connection, so multi-account is plausible at action level but not confirmed in docs read. Each MCP call uses 2 tasks.
candidates.google_workspace: Gmail actions (draft, archive, trash, etc.); Drive/Calendar via apps; r/w by action.
candidates.recommend_why: Plausible multi-account Google through named connections, and a bridge into other clients; verify.

candidates.name: Jenova
candidates.connectors: Agents connect to Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive and other apps (homepage)
candidates.mcp: unknown (homepage does not mention MCP; a third-party profile says it connects to MCP servers)
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. Consumer-leaning; tiers Free..Ultra, Enterprise. Needs docs read.
candidates.google_workspace: Gmail, Calendar, Drive named; scope unknown.
candidates.recommend_why: Lists all three Google apps but no MCP or multi-account evidence.

candidates.name: meinGPT
candidates.connectors: Gmail, Calendar, Drive as standalone connectors in user context; Notion read/write; custom MCP server tile
candidates.mcp: remote (public HTTPS, optional OAuth or header token)
candidates.note: New 2026-10-31. EU enterprise chat platform. Google write scope not stated.
candidates.google_workspace: Gmail, Calendar, Drive standalone connectors, user context; r/w not stated.
candidates.recommend_why: Standalone Google connectors plus custom MCP, worth one more doc read.
